title: Native total-tensor forgetting with prescribed summands
statement: Let k0 be a finite field, l a prime and X a k0-scheme. Let T be a native tensor bifunctor additive in both variables, with its sum-total tensor complexes, and let e identify its ordinary underlying tensor with ordinaryTensorBifunctor [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. For all pairs P,Q of unbounded native complexes there is a chain isomorphism from the forgotten sum-total T(P,Q) to the ordinary sum-total tensor of the forgotten complexes. On the summand of total degree n indexed by p+q=n, its composite with the forgotten inclusion is e at P.X(p),Q.X(q) followed by the ordinary summand inclusion. No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Curry e by using its components at pairs of modules. Naturality for the two curried variables is naturality of e on pairs (identity,g) and (f,identity).

proof.text: Apply the existing total bifunctor comparison [lem-pc-total-bifunctor-comparison-iso], namely HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison to this curried isomorphism. Native forgetting preserves the defining coproducts, and every component of the curried comparison is invertible, so the source comparison API makes the resulting chain map invertible. The source map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX equation is exactly the prescribed summand identity. Its chain-map equation already includes the two signed differential terms.

theorem native_weil_tensor_chain
    (T : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤ ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ⥤
      ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X)
    [T.Additive] [∀ P, (T.obj P).Additive]
    [∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ, P.HasMapBifunctor Q T]
    (e : Functor.uncurry.obj T ⋙
        Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X) ≅
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).prod
        (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj
            (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)) :
    ∃ chain : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ,
      ((Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget
        (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q T) ≅
        ordinaryTensorTotal l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
          (((Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget
            (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget
            (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
    ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
      (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).map
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q T (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫
            (chain P Q).hom.f n =
        e.hom.app (P.X p, Q.X q) ≫ HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
          (((Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget
            (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget
            (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
          (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
          (.up ℤ) p q n h
